S1.membership_semantics: canonical recurring membership only; membership does not imply enabled state or worker liveness
S1.enabled_state_authority: current ChatGPT scheduler state in the owning account

recurring_worker_partition_rule: At most five recurring scheduler workers globally; the current canonical recurring fleet is S1; recurring workers never administer themselves or any sibling.

routine_recurring_recovery.peer_recovery: Recurring workers may observe bounded fleet-watch evidence but must never issue scheduler mutations against their own or any sibling automation. Exact guarded recovery belongs to the supervising/manual ChatGPT session or explicit operator handoff and must keep the enabled recurring count at or below five.

manual_workers.active_count_authority: live MCP/runtime evidence; manual current reports are purpose/freshness hints only
manual_workers.total_swarm_semantics: up to 5 recurring workers plus any concurrently active manual/on-demand workers

handoff.note: Former S2 recurring topology is historical evidence only, not current canonical recurring membership. Scheduler state outside the current owning account must be verified in that account before making live-state claims.
